    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/74293321/svelte@5.57.0</id>
    <updated>2026-08-28T23:31:40Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/releases/tag/svelte%405.57.0"/>
    <title>svelte@5.57.0</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Minor Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>feat: export <code>RenderOutput</code>, <code>SyncRenderOutput</code>, <code>Csp</code> and <code>Sha256Source</code> from <code>svelte/server</code> (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18648" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18648/hovercard">#18648</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>feat: add <code>has</code> function to <code>createContext</code> (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18472" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18472/hovercard">#18472</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>feat: support <code>defaultValue</code> on <code>&lt;select&gt;</code> (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18591" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18591/hovercard">#18591</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>feat: add getOrInsert/getOrInsertComputed to SvelteMap (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18728" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18728/hovercard">#18728</a>)</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3>Patch Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>fix: block template store subscriptions on the promise that assigns the store (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18582" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18582/hovercard">#18582</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: route $derived teardown errors through invoke_error_boundary (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18486" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18486/hovercard">#18486</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: track SvelteDate snapshots in reactions (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18700" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18700/hovercard">#18700</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: remove <code>&lt;svelte:head&gt;</code> anchors on unmount (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18697" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18697/hovercard">#18697</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: warn on undeclared shorthand event handlers on <code>&lt;svelte:window&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;svelte:document&gt;</code> and <code>&lt;svelte:body&gt;</code> (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18480" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18480/hovercard">#18480</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>perf: reuse the cached value in the <code>&lt;option&gt;</code>/<code>&lt;select&gt;</code> value guard (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18713" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18713/hovercard">#18713</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: prevent malformed AST output for <code>&lt;select&gt;</code> with static <code>value</code> attribute (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18449" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18449/hovercard">#18449</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: apply ownership mutation ignores to binding assignments (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18718" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18718/hovercard">#18718</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: prevent onoutroend from firing twice when compilerOptions.hmr is true (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18655" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18655/hovercard">#18655</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: preserve whitespace after inline elements when printing (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18685" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18685/hovercard">#18685</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>perf: fold SSR block-open markers into the branch's first push (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18712" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18712/hovercard">#18712</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: run <code>onDestroy</code> callbacks when a server render throws (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18585" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18585/hovercard">#18585</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: report <code>derived_invalid_export</code> for <code>export let x = $derived(...)</code> in runes mode (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18692" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18692/hovercard">#18692</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: never apply class hash to elements inside <code>&lt;svelte:head&gt;</code> (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18160" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18160/hovercard">#18160</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: keep <code>defaultChecked</code> on hydrated radio inputs with spread attributes (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18701" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18701/hovercard">#18701</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: accept <code>onfocusin</code>/<code>onfocusout</code> in <code>a11y_mouse_events_have_key_events</code> (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18689" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18689/hovercard">#18689</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>perf: O(n²)→O(n) Map lookups for legacy <code>$:</code> reactive statement ordering (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18602" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18602/hovercard">#18602</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: distinct memoizer on style/class directives (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18466" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18466/hovercard">#18466</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: measure nested transitions before applying their starting styles (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18647" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18647/hovercard">#18647</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: don't turn component instances stored in <code>$state</code> into state proxies (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18646" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18646/hovercard">#18646</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>perf: emit <code>$.only_child</code> for elements with a single child (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18717" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18717/hovercard">#18717</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: omit <code>bind:focused</code> from SSR output (it has no HTML attribute) (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18724" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18724/hovercard">#18724</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: more robust rendering of Svelte custom element slots (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18710" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18710/hovercard">#18710</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>perf: optimize simple object destructuring in <code>@const</code> tags (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18390" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18390/hovercard">#18390</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: properly apply static textarea value attribute during CSR (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18727" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18727/hovercard">#18727</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: end a restored reaction context at the end of its synchronous segment (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18694" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18694/hovercard">#18694</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: keep the dependencies of a reaction that throws, so deriveds it read are neither leaked nor stuck in their error (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18703" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18703/hovercard">#18703</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: don't resurrect outroing elements when an ancestor block is paused and resumed (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18431" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18431/hovercard">#18431</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>perf: use <code>$.comment()</code> for single-comment templates (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18714" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18714/hovercard">#18714</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>chore: move <code>@types/trusted-types</code> to devDependencies (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18730" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18730/hovercard">#18730</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>perf: store setters cache as <code>Set</code> instead of <code>Array</code> (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18251" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18251/hovercard">#18251</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: transform derived assignments and select function bindings correctly during server-side rendering (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18669" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18669/hovercard">#18669</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: keep boolean attributes with an empty string value when rendering attribute objects on the server (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18721" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18721/hovercard">#18721</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: sync <code>SvelteURL</code> port signal when the protocol setter clears the port (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18705" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18705/hovercard">#18705</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: block declaration tags and <code>{@const}</code> on async values read inside closures (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18533" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18533/hovercard">#18533</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: avoid css tree-shaking for exported Snippet (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18540" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18540/hovercard">#18540</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>perf: treat <code>&lt;img loading&gt;</code> as a static element again (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18711" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18711/hovercard">#18711</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: prevent <code>selectedcontent</code> mutation from changing the selected option (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18495" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18495/hovercard">#18495</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: avoid <code>NaN</code> keyframe values in <code>slide</code> transition for elements without a layout box (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18430" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18430/hovercard">#18430</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: preserve line feed character references in attribute values (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18691" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18691/hovercard">#18691</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: decode uppercase-<code>X</code> hex numeric character references (<code>&amp;#X...;</code>) (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18708" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18708/hovercard">#18708</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>chore: clarify when <code>$effect.pre</code> runs relative to DOM updates (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18534" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18534/hovercard">#18534</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: scope SSR boundary failed snippets to their boundary (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18593" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18593/hovercard">#18593</a>)</p>
</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/74293321/svelte@5.56.10</id>
    <updated>2026-08-20T19:20:58Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/releases/tag/svelte%405.56.10"/>
    <title>svelte@5.56.10</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Patch Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>fix: preserve CSS escape sequences when printing selectors (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18667" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18667/hovercard">#18667</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: parse <code>:nth-child(2n of.foo)</code> where <code>of</code> is not followed by whitespace (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18611" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18611/hovercard">#18611</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: transform expressions inside labeled statements during server compilation (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18617" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18617/hovercard">#18617</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>docs: clarify that context lookup includes the current component and all ancestors (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18581" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18581/hovercard">#18581</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: apply CSS custom properties with falsy values on components (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18634" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18634/hovercard">#18634</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: correctly print <code>{#await ... catch x}</code> et al (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18645" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18645/hovercard">#18645</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: ignore comments of Program node during migration script (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18656" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18656/hovercard">#18656</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: reliably resolve append_style to its correct root (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18614" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18614/hovercard">#18614</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: clean up removed capture event handlers from spread attributes (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18618" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18618/hovercard">#18618</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: don't corrupt renderer type during SSR's legacy <code>bind:</code> retry loop (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18616" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18616/hovercard">#18616</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: treat concise arrow function bodies as implicit returns when calculating blockers (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18613" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18613/hovercard">#18613</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: give effect teardowns the value from before the first write in a flush (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18620" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18620/hovercard">#18620</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: avoid double-calling a derived reference when destructuring <code>$derived</code> of another <code>$derived</code> during server-side rendering (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18668" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18668/hovercard">#18668</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: preserve namespaces in CSS type selectors (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18678" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18678/hovercard">#18678</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: increment private state fields through a non-<code>this</code> receiver (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18622" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18622/hovercard">#18622</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>chore: deduplicate client and server context helpers (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18580" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18580/hovercard">#18580</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: release <code>last_propagated_event</code> after event propagation settles so it no longer retains the last event's target subtree (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18569" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18569/hovercard">#18569</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: allow custom elements to receive async values as props (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18661" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18661/hovercard">#18661</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: strip comments from inline <code>style</code> values in linear time (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18553" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18553/hovercard">#18553</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: prevent declaration comments from breaking server derived references (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18641" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18641/hovercard">#18641</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>perf: make async blocker analysis scale linearly with the number of top-level references (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18549" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18549/hovercard">#18549</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: preserve short-circuiting for logical assignments to private state fields (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18594" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18594/hovercard">#18594</a>)</p>
</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/74293321/svelte@5.56.9</id>
    <updated>2026-08-12T18:12:41Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/releases/tag/svelte%405.56.9"/>
    <title>svelte@5.56.9</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>Patch Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p>fix: skip controlled each fast path while another batch is pending (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18625" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18625/hovercard">#18625</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: better whitespace handling inside printer (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18638" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18638/hovercard">#18638</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>fix: don't duplicate comments in attributes (<a href="https://github.com/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18636" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/sveltejs/svelte/pull/18636/hovercard">#18636</a>)</p>
</li>
<li>
